# Parallel Iterator and Checked Mapping Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Finish Wave 14 by adding `ParElements`, `TensorBase::par_iter()`, `par_map_checked`, and the final crate-internal re-export surface in `src/parallel/mod.rs`.

**Architecture:** `parallel/iter.rs` provides the read-only single-input parallel iterator entry. `parallel/checked.rs` provides checked mapping with `Result` propagation. `parallel/mod.rs` becomes the crate-internal integration boundary re-exporting the backend surface required by semantic modules.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, optional `rayon` 1.10, `TensorBase`, `TensorView`, `XenonError`

**Design Docs:** `design/09-parallel.md` §3, §5.4, §6.5, §6.6, §8.2, §9.1

**Prerequisites:** W14T1 must be complete.

```rust
use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::Element;
use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::{Tensor, TensorBase};

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
pub(crate) fn par_map_checked<A, B, S, D, F>(
    tensor: &TensorBase<S, D>,
    f: F,
) -> Result<Tensor<B, D>, XenonError>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension + Clone,
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
    B: Element + Send,
    F: Fn(&A) -> Result<B, XenonError> + Sync + Send,
{
    let _ = (tensor, f);
    Err(XenonError::InvalidShape {
        operation: "par_map_checked".into(),
        shape: tensor.shape().to_vec(),
        expected_elements: tensor.len(),
        actual_elements: 0,
        offending_dim: None,
        reason: Some("replace scaffold in Step 3".into()),
    })
}
```

Replace `src/parallel/iter.rs` with:

```rust
#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
use rayon::prelude::*;

use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::Element;
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::{TensorBase, TensorView};

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
pub(crate) struct ParElements<'a, A, D>
where
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
    D: Dimension,
{
    base: TensorView<'a, A, D>,
}

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
impl<'a, A, D> ParElements<'a, A, D>
where
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
    D: Dimension,
{
    pub(crate) fn new(base: TensorView<'a, A, D>) -> Self {
        Self { base }
    }

    pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.base.len()
    }

    pub(crate) fn map<B, F>(&self, f: F) -> Vec<B>
    where
        B: Send,
        F: Fn(&A) -> B + Sync + Send,
    {
        self.base.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().into_par_iter().map(f).collect()
    }
}

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
impl<S, D, A> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension + Clone,
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
{
    pub(crate) fn par_iter(&self) -> ParElements<'_, A, D> {
        ParElements::new(self.view())
    }
}
```

Replace `src/parallel/checked.rs` with:

```rust
#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
use rayon::prelude::*;

use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::Element;
use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::{Tensor, TensorBase};

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
pub(crate) fn par_map_checked<A, B, S, D, F>(
    tensor: &TensorBase<S, D>,
    f: F,
) -> Result<Tensor<B, D>, XenonError>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension + Clone,
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
    B: Element + Send,
    F: Fn(&A) -> Result<B, XenonError> + Sync + Send,
{
    let output: Result<Vec<B>, XenonError> = tensor
        .par_iter()
        .map(|x| f(x))
        .into_par_iter()
        .collect();

    Ok(unsafe { Tensor::from_raw_vec_unchecked(output?, tensor.raw_dim()) })
}
```
